These pinned dependencies are served locally so charts and resource icons do not depend on an external CDN.

- D3 7.9.2: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.2/dist/d3.min.js`; license in `d3-LICENSE`.
- Phosphor Icons 2.1.2, regular weight: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@phosphor-icons/web@2.1.2/src/regular/`; license in `phosphor-2.1.2/LICENSE`. The stylesheet retains the WOFF2 font source.
